currentUserGoal: Make the mobile layout spend much less space on non-player-field UI while leaving the desktop/web layout alone.
changesMade: Added a true mobile HUD chip height and tighter mobile HUD spacing so the title, build label, resource chips, goal nudge, and milestone text use less vertical space.
Hid the mobile Test button unless the mobile test URL flag is active, so normal mobile players get more bottom space.
Changed the mobile command dock to use up to four compact columns, smaller padding, smaller gaps, and lighter framing.
Reduced mobile-only board bottom reserve and moved compact mobile boards higher in the available play area.
Increased compact mobile board zoom and reduced mobile compact board inset so mid-size phone fields show larger grass tiles.
Bumped the mobile test URL version to mobile-field-focus-1.
